form.name: Name
form.descriptionPlaceholder: A short description of the property for guests
form.channelListingsIntro: Add each platform where this listing is published. Top field: object ID in that channel (Booking, Airbnb, …). Below: object ID in Zodomus (filled by “Load from Zodomus”).
form.channelsEmptyHint: No OTA channels yet. Add Booking, Airbnb, or both — each needs its own external listing id.
form.manualZodomusStandaloneHint: If you are not connecting Booking or Airbnb here, enter the Zodomus property id manually — for sync, reservation queue, and webhooks.
form.duplicateOtaChannel: Each channel can only appear once. Remove the duplicate row.
form.syncFlowPickIntro: Start by choosing how this listing connects to external platforms. You can change this later.
form.syncFlowUnlockHint: Tap Booking, Airbnb, or “Not linked” above to open the next section.
form.syncFlowNoOtaLead: Without Booking or Airbnb, only iCal import applies — use it to block dates from other calendars.
form.channelPickerIntro: Choose where this listing is primarily distributed. This sets the Zodomus channel used for availability and reservation sync.
form.channelNoneHint: Direct bookings only; iCal import in the next step.
form.zodomusObjectIdHint: “Load from Zodomus” fills this with the Zodomus object id. If there are several room types, pick one below — the room id is stored for rates and availability.
form.zodomusPropertyIdHintBooking: Property ID from Booking.com extranet (external object id for this channel).
form.zodomusPropertyIdHintAirbnb: External object id for this channel (as in Zodomus for Airbnb).
form.icalBlockIntro: Optional: import other calendars as blocked dates (no guest details).
form.previewNeedId: Enter the object ID for this channel (OTA) first.
form.previewToastMultiRoom: {count} room types found — pick the right one below.
form.previewRoomsSubtitle: Choose the one that matches this RentAI listing.
form.previewRoomsSingle: One room type — change the selection below if needed.
form.previewToastRoomsLoaded: Loaded {count} room types — pick one below.
form.previewToastInvalidPropertyId: Zodomus rejected this id. Use the external object id for this channel (OTA), not a room id from the list.
form.zodomusPropertyIdHintLoad: The request uses the Object ID (channel) field above; the response fills this field and listing name/address.
form.zodomusPreviewNoAddressHint: Zodomus «room-rates» usually returns only rooms and rates — not the hotel address. Fill country/city/address manually or from your OTA extranet.
form.previewRoomRatesIntro: Rate plans attached to each room — these IDs are what you’ll use later for pricing and availability rules.
form.previewRoomRatesFootnote: Nightly amounts are not returned here — only rate IDs and labels. Address and country are usually missing from room-rates; fill listing details manually or copy from the OTA extranet.
form.zodomusPropertyIdHint: External id from Zodomus (sandbox / backoffice). Required to sync OTA bookings into the calendar. Leave empty if not connected.
form.zodomusRoomIdHint: Required for availability push when Zodomus has more than one room type for this property — set the room id that matches this RentAI listing. If Zodomus has only one room, you can leave this empty.
form.icalImportUrlsHint: One URL per line — Airbnb, Booking.com export, or other .ics feeds. Invalid lines are ignored. Save the form, then use “Refresh iCal” on the property page.

integrations.title: Calendar & channel sync
integrations.subtitle: Subscribe other platforms to this calendar, import external blocks, and pull existing Zodomus reservations.
integrations.exportHint: Paste this URL in the other platform as “import calendar” or sync URL. It lists confirmed bookings from RentAI (guest names are hidden).
integrations.exportCopyFailed: Could not copy — copy the link manually
integrations.icalSyncHint: Fetches all URLs saved in the form above and updates blocked dates in RentAI.
integrations.icalSyncError: iCal sync failed — check URLs and try again
integrations.zodomusImportHint: One-time pull of active future reservations from Zodomus (use after linking the Zodomus property id). Channel 1 is typical for Booking.com sandbox.
integrations.zodomusImportError: Import failed — is Zodomus enabled and the property id correct?
integrations.zodomusImportDisabledHint: Set Zodomus property id in the form first
integrations.zodomusQueueHint: Processes the Zodomus reservations queue for this property (one GET /reservations per item). Use when the channel manager has pending new or modified bookings. This is not the same as “Import future reservations” (that uses a bulk summary endpoint).
integrations.zodomusQueueChannelHint: Uses the channel ID entered above.
integrations.zodomusQueueForce: Re-fetch reservations already marked as synced (force)
integrations.zodomusQueueEmpty: Zodomus queue is empty — nothing to process.
integrations.zodomusQueueAllSkipped: Nothing new: {skipped} skipped (already synced). Enable force to re-download.
integrations.zodomusQueueError: Queue sync failed — check Zodomus settings and backend logs.
